name: BollingerBandsEA Ver3.0
summary: This EA trades Bollinger Band mean reversion signals, entering long when price touches the lower band and entering short when price touches the upper band, expecting a return to the moving average. Version 3.0 likely adds position management and risk controls on top of the core band-based entry logic. It is a fully automated systematic strategy targeting ranging markets.
summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带均值回归信号交易，价格触及下轨时做多，触及上轨时做空，预期价格回归中轨。3.0版本可能在核心布林带入场逻辑基础上增加了仓位管理和风险控制。这是一个全自动化系统策略，适用于震荡行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是布林带均值回归，利用价格偏离中轨后回归的统计特性进行交易。入场条件为：价格触及或突破布林带下轨时开多单，价格触及或突破布林带上轨时开空单，认为价格过度偏离将回归均值。出场条件通常包括价格回归中轨时平仓获利，以及止损设定在布林带外侧一定距离作为风控。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式。资金管理方面，止损与布林带宽度相关联，利用带宽自适应调整止损距离。该策略在震荡行情中表现良好，但在强趋势行情中可能遭遇连续亏损，因为价格可能沿布林带轨道持续运行而不回归。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is Bollinger Band mean reversion, exploiting the statistical tendency of price to revert to the mean after deviating from the middle band. Entry conditions: open a long position when price touches or breaks below the lower Bollinger Band, and open a short position when price touches or breaks above the upper band, on the assumption that overextension will correct. Exit conditions typically include taking profit when price returns to the middle band, and placing a stop loss at a defined distance beyond the band edge for risk control. Position sizing may use fixed lots or an account-balance-proportional method. Money management ties stop-loss distance to Bollinger Band width, creating an adaptive stop that widens in volatile markets and tightens in calm ones. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but can suffer consecutive losses during strong trends, as price may ride the band edge without reverting.

pros: 布林带自适应波动率，在市场波动变化时自动调整入场和止损范围
均值回归逻辑在震荡市中有较高的胜率和稳定的盈利能力
策略逻辑清晰直观，参数少，易于理解和调优
pros_en: Bollinger Bands adapt to volatility automatically, adjusting entry and stop-loss ranges as market conditions change
Mean reversion logic achieves high win rates and stable profitability in ranging markets
Clear and intuitive strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
cons: 在强趋势行情中可能连续亏损，价格沿布林带边缘运行而不回归
缺少趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡市和趋势市，导致不利行情中频繁开仓
固定手数或简单比例仓位无法根据布林带宽度或市场状态动态调整风险敞口
cons_en: Can suffer consecutive losses in strong trends as price rides the band edge without reverting
Lacks a trend filter to distinguish ranging from trending conditions, leading to frequent entries in unfavorable markets
Fixed lot or simple proportional sizing cannot dynamically adjust risk exposure based on band width or market regime
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或大周期均线），在趋势行情中暂停交易或反转策略
引入动态仓位管理，根据布林带带宽或ATR调整手数，控制每笔风险百分比
增加移动止盈或部分平仓机制，在价格回归中轨途中锁定部分利润
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher-timeframe MA) to pause trading or switch strategy during trending markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on Bollinger Band width or ATR to control per-trade risk percentage
Add a trailing stop or partial close mechanism to lock in profits as price reverts toward the middle band

risk_points: 缺少趋势行情过滤机制，强趋势中可能连续止损
若止损设为0或依赖布林带外轨，极端行情下可能滑点远超预期
未提及是否存在新K线检查，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: No trend filter mechanism, leading to consecutive stop-losses in strong trends
If stop-loss is set to 0 or relies on the outer band, extreme market moves can cause slippage far exceeding expectations
No mention of new bar check, potentially allowing repeated entries within the same candle
